verses.ar: «أَتَصْطَادُ لَوِيَاثَانَ بِشِصٍّ، أَوْ تَضْغَطُ لِسَانَهُ بِحَبْلٍ؟
verses.kjv: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord [which] thou lettest down?
verses.web: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?

verses.ar: أَتَضَعُ أَسَلَةً فِي خَطْمِهِ، أَمْ تَثْقُبُ فَكَّهُ بِخِزَامَةٍ؟
verses.kjv: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
verses.web: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?

verses.ar: أَيُكْثِرُ ٱلتَّضَرُّعَاتِ إِلَيْكَ، أَمْ يَتَكَلَّمُ مَعَكَ بِٱللِّينِ؟
verses.kjv: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft [words] unto thee?
verses.web: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?

verses.ar: هَلْ يَقْطَعُ مَعَكَ عَهْدًا فَتَتَّخِذَهُ عَبْدًا مُؤَبَّدًا؟
verses.kjv: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?
verses.web: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?

verses.ar: أَتَلْعَبُ مَعَهُ كَٱلْعُصْفُورِ، أَوْ تَرْبِطُهُ لِأَجْلِ فَتَيَاتِكَ؟
verses.kjv: Wilt thou play with him as [with] a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?
verses.web: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?

verses.ar: هَلْ تَحْفِرُ جَمَاعَةُ ٱلصَّيَّادِينَ لِأَجْلِهِ حُفْرَةً، أَوْ يَقْسِمُونَهُ بَيْنَ ٱلْكَنْعَانِيِّينَ؟
verses.kjv: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?
verses.web: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?

verses.ar: أَتَمْلَأُ جِلْدَهُ حِرَابًا وَرَأْسَهُ بِإِلَالِ ٱلسَّمَكِ؟
verses.kjv: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?
verses.web: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?

verses.ar: ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَيْهِ. لَا تَعُدْ تَذْكُرُ ٱلْقِتَالَ!
verses.kjv: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
verses.web: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.

verses.ar: هُوَذَا ٱلرَّجَاءُ بِهِ كَاذِبٌ. أَلَا يُكَبُّ أَيْضًا بِرُؤْيَتِهِ؟
verses.kjv: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not [one] be cast down even at the sight of him?
verses.web: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?

verses.ar: لَيْسَ مِنْ شُجَاعٍ يُوقِظُهُ، فَمَنْ يَقِفُ إِذًا بِوَجْهِي؟
verses.kjv: None [is so] fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
verses.web: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?

verses.ar: مَنْ تَقَدَّمَنِي فَأُوفِيَهُ؟ مَا تَحْتَ كُلِّ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ هُوَ لِي.
verses.kjv: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay [him? whatsoever is] under the whole heaven is mine.
verses.web: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.

verses.ar: «لَا أَسْكُتُ عَنْ أَعْضَائِهِ، وَخَبَرِ قُوَّتِهِ وَبَهْجَةِ عُدَّتِهِ.
verses.kjv: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
verses.web: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.

verses.ar: مَنْ يَكْشِفُ وَجْهَ لِبْسِهِ، وَمَنْ يَدْنُو مِنْ مَثْنَى لَجَمَتِهِ؟
verses.kjv: Who can discover the face of his garment? [or] who can come [to him] with his double bridle?
verses.web: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?

verses.ar: مَنْ يَفْتَحُ مِصْرَاعَيْ فَمِهِ؟ دَائِرَةُ أَسْنَانِهِ مُرْعِبَةٌ.
verses.kjv: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth [are] terrible round about.
verses.web: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.

verses.ar: فَخْرُهُ مَجَانُّ مَانِعَةٌ مُحَكَّمَةٌ مَضْغُوطَةٌ بِخَاتِمٍ.
verses.kjv: [His] scales [are his] pride, shut up together [as with] a close seal.
verses.web: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.

verses.ar: ٱلْوَاحِدُ يَمَسُّ ٱلْآخَرَ، فَٱلرِّيحُ لَا تَدْخُلُ بَيْنَهَا.
verses.kjv: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
verses.web: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

verses.ar: كُلٌّ مِنْهَا مُلْتَصِقٌ بِصَاحِبِهِ، مُتَلَكِّدَةً لَا تَنْفَصِلُ.
verses.kjv: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
verses.web: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.

verses.ar: عُطَاسُهُ يَبْعَثُ نُورًا، وَعَيْنَاهُ كَهُدُبِ ٱلصُّبْحِ.
verses.kjv: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes [are] like the eyelids of the morning.
verses.web: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

verses.ar: مِنْ فِيهِ تَخْرُجُ مَصَابِيحُ. شَرَارُ نَارٍ تَتَطَايَرُ مِنْهُ.
verses.kjv: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, [and] sparks of fire leap out.
verses.web: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.

verses.ar: مِنْ مَنْخَرَيْهِ يَخْرُجُ دُخَانٌ كَأَنَّهُ مِنْ قِدْرٍ مَنْفُوخٍ أَوْ مِنْ مِرْجَلٍ.
verses.kjv: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as [out] of a seething pot or caldron.
verses.web: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

verses.ar: نَفَسُهُ يُشْعِلُ جَمْرًا، وَلَهِيبٌ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ فِيهِ.
verses.kjv: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.
verses.web: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.

verses.ar: فِي عُنُقِهِ تَبِيتُ ٱلْقُوَّةُ، وَأَمَامَهُ يَدُوسُ ٱلْهَوْلُ.
verses.kjv: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.
verses.web: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.

verses.ar: مَطَاوِي لَحْمِهِ مُتَلَاصِقَةٌ مَسْبُوكَةٌ عَلَيْهِ لَا تَتَحَرَّكُ.
verses.kjv: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.
verses.web: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.

verses.ar: قَلْبُهُ صُلْبٌ كَٱلْحَجَرِ، وَقَاسٍ كَٱلرَّحَى.
verses.kjv: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether [millstone].
verses.web: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.

verses.ar: عِنْدَ نُهُوضِهِ تَفْزَعُ ٱلْأَقْوِيَاءُ. مِنَ ٱلْمَخَاوِفِ يَتِيهُونَ.
verses.kjv: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.
verses.web: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.

verses.ar: سَيْفُ ٱلَّذِي يَلْحَقُهُ لَا يَقُومُ، وَلَا رُمْحٌ وَلَا مِزْرَاقٌ وَلَا دِرْعٌ.
verses.kjv: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
verses.web: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

verses.ar: يَحْسِبُ ٱلْحَدِيدَ كَٱلتِّبْنِ، وَٱلنُّحَاسَ كَٱلْعُودِ ٱلنَّخِرِ.
verses.kjv: He esteemeth iron as straw, [and] brass as rotten wood.
verses.web: He counts iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.

verses.ar: لَا يَسْتَفِزُّهُ نُبْلُ ٱلْقَوْسِ. حِجَارَةُ ٱلْمِقْلَاعِ تَرْجِعُ عَنْهُ كَٱلْقَشِّ.
verses.kjv: The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
verses.web: The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.

verses.ar: يَحْسَبُ ٱلْمِقْمَعَةَ كَقَشٍّ، وَيَضْحَكُ عَلَى ٱهْتِزَازِ ٱلرُّمْحِ.
verses.kjv: Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.
verses.web: Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.

verses.ar: تَحْتَهُ قُطَعُ خَزَفٍ حَادَّةٌ. يُمَدِّدُ نَوْرَجًا عَلَى ٱلطِّينِ.
verses.kjv: Sharp stones [are] under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.
verses.web: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

verses.ar: يَجْعَلُ ٱلْعُمْقَ يَغْلِي كَٱلْقِدْرِ، وَيَجْعَلُ ٱلْبَحْرَ كَقِدْرِ عِطَارَةٍ.
verses.kjv: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
verses.web: He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

verses.ar: يُضِيءُ ٱلسَّبِيلُ وَرَاءَهُ فَيُحْسَبُ ٱللُّجُّ أَشْيَبَ.
verses.kjv: He maketh a path to shine after him; [one] would think the deep [to be] hoary.
verses.web: He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.

verses.ar: لَيْسَ لَهُ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ نَظِيرٌ. صُنِعَ لِعَدَمِ ٱلْخَوْفِ.
verses.kjv: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
verses.web: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.

verses.ar: يُشْرِفُ عَلَى كُلِّ مُتَعَالٍ. هُوَ مَلِكٌ عَلَى كُلِّ بَنِي ٱلْكِبْرِيَاءِ».
verses.kjv: He beholdeth all high [things:] he [is] a king over all the children of pride.
verses.web: He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”
